svg.title: Four Core People; Six at Scaled Capacity
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-core-and-scaled-pod-architecture; chart type: org_architecture; title: Four Core People; Six at Scaled Capacity; subtitle: Base pod: 1 FT + 3 C. Scaled pod: 2 FT + 4 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT means full-time operator; C means contracted specialist. The first four seats form the Conservative and Base pod. The final two seats are added only for the Scaled scenario. Counsel must possess the competence required by the accepted case mix; narrow the service scope if the retained professional cannot cover it. Software and licensed data subscriptions are tools, not additional seats.; caption: Conservative revenue and profit are $110,000 and $35,200; Base figures are $515,000 and $231,750; Scaled figures are $920,000 and $533,600 with six people.; stages: label: Owner and recovery lead; value: Core seat 1; full-time operator; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own client acquisition, contract economics, lane assignment, cash forecasting, fee reconciliation, and account-level exception decisions. Maintain separation between operator consideration and funds belonging to the claimant.; label: Licensed customs broker; value: Core seat 2; contracted professional; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Execute authorized customs business under 19 CFR Part 111. Validate drawback routes, PSC availability, protest submissions, POA scope, and bond arrangements while preserving filing acknowledgments and supporting records.; label: Evidence reconciliation analyst; value: Core seat 3; contracted specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Match ACE entry lines to source invoices, inventory events, and export bills of lading. Assemble settlement purchase evidence, track reconciliation exceptions, and maintain the duplicate-claim ledger across all three lanes.; label: Trade and settlement counsel; value: Core seat 4; contracted professional; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Resolve complex statutory eligibility, protest grounds, settlement-class interpretation, and filer-disclosure requirements. Escalate disputes beyond the contracted scope rather than letting administrative staff make unsupported legal determinations.; label: Operations and collections lead; value: Scaled seat 5; second full-time operator; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Take over deadline monitoring, evidence-request scheduling, status reconciliation, invoice collections, and operating capacity planning. Add this seat against demonstrated workload and collected fee capacity.; label: Settlement ledger specialist; value: Scaled seat 6; fourth contractor; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Reconcile high-volume accounts-payable and processor exports, normalize class-period purchases, resolve entity mapping, and package administrator responses without substituting purchase totals for distributable recovery estimates.
